## Evidence

Attach a fresh `WorldWarVR.log` and a screenshot or short video if useful.
Remove personal information before posting publicly. Do not attach game
executables, proprietary map/assets, saves, passwords, tokens, or private DMs.
Ordinary game logs may not identify the failing DLL for startup errors;
maintainers may request a separate targeted diagnostic privately.
